# Idle — Web Playables

> A parked browser-game lab with one playable idle game and a reusable gamekit for web and YouTube Playables distribution.

## Public surfaces

- [Project overview](https://idle.aliveville.com/index.md): Purpose, proof, and current held state.
- [Idle Startup](https://idle.aliveville.com/play/idle-startup/): The retained browser-playable idle game.
